title: The Dialect Tax: Dialectal Biases Persist throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2608.24952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systematic dialectal performance gaps in language models (LMs) are well documented, but the source of these disparities within the modern language modeling pipeline remains unclear. Our study traces this "dialect tax" across the natural language processing pipeline. Using parallel English dialect corpora that hold meaning fixed while varying surface form, we first confirm that LMs recognize matched Standard American English (SAE) and dialectal texts as semantically equivalent. However, we discover further representational gaps corresponding to downstream performance gaps. Across model families and generations, modern LMs still encode dialectal texts unequally during tokenization, pre-training, post-training, and inference. Strikingly, bypassing traditional subword segmentation via a character-level counterfactual tokenizer removes neither input and output asymmetries nor dialectal accuracy gaps. translated_title: 方言税：语言建模流程中方言偏见持续存在
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LMs）中系统性的方言性能差距已有充分记录，但这些差异在现代语言建模流程中的来源仍不清楚。我们的研究追踪了这一“方言税”在自然语言处理流程中的表现。使用平行英语方言语料库（这些语料库在保持意义不变的同时改变表面形式），我们首先确认LMs能够识别标准美式英语（SAE）和方言文本在语义上等价。然而，我们发现了与下游性能差距相对应的进一步表征差距。跨模型家族和世代，现代LMs在分词、预训练、后训练和推理过程中仍然不平等地编码方言文本。令人惊讶的是，通过字符级反事实分词器绕过传统的子词分割，既没有消除输入和输出的不对称性，也没有消除方言准确性差距。在预训练期间，方言对引发...
tldr: 本文揭示了现代语言模型在整个处理流程中（包括分词、预训练、后训练和推理）持续存在方言偏见，即使使用字符级分词器也无法消除，导致方言文本性能持续落后于标准美式英语。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that modern language models persistently exhibit dialectal biases throughout the entire processing pipeline—including tokenization, pre-training, post-training, and inference—which cannot be eliminated even with character-level tokenizers, resulting in consistent performance gaps for dialectal texts compared to Standard American English.
